snippet.title: Gelatia: don't defeat monsters, sweeten them | Trailer #idlerpg
snippet.description:
Don't defeat monsters. Sweeten them.

A sour witch has soured a kingdom of desserts, and one tiny slime has to fix it. Gelatia is a free idle RPG for Android: your slime fights on its own through 30 lands, and every guardian turns sweet when you win.

Play free on Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.b8ne.gelatia&referrer=utm_source%3Dyoutube%26utm_medium%3Dtrailer%26utm_campaign%3Dlaunch

- Before every boss, the game tells you how far you'll get
- x1, x10 and x50 summons, with the odds one tap away and a Legendary guaranteed by pull 150
- Tower, mine, dungeon, guilds and an Arena against real players' teams
- Close the game and your slime keeps fighting
- No forced ads: a video only plays if you tap it

Discord: https://discord.gg/VFjDPKWGmT
Website: https://b8ne.dev/gelatia/
Press kit: https://b8ne.dev/gelatia/press/

#gelatia #idlerpg #mobilegame #androidgames
